title: Path helpers
description:
Write the small path functions every Windows program needs.

```
join("C:\Games", "save\slot1.dat") -> C:\Games\save\slot1.dat
changeExtension("notes.txt", ".md") -> notes.md
fileName("C:\a\b\report.pdf") -> report.pdf
longPath("C:\very\long\...") -> \\?\C:\very\long\...
```
hints: `\\?\` turns off the 260-character limit for the Unicode file functions, but also turns off `.` and `..` handling, so normalise first.
requirements: Use `std::filesystem::path` for join, extension and file name.
`longPath` adds the `\\?\` prefix only to absolute paths that do not have it.
Compare paths ignoring case, as Windows does.
stretch: Find the user's documents folder with `SHGetKnownFolderPath(FOLDERID_Documents, ...)`.
